phase: independent concept panel and baseline sampling
reference: IE-CoR 1.1, Heggarty, Anderson and Scarborough (2024), CC-BY 4.0
concept_panel: Census of all between-language form combinations in the five selected modern varieties
matching: NFC, trim, casefold; exact reference spelling. No guessed lemmas or edit-distance mapping.
existing_sample: 5 undirected rows per language-pair/category via seeded reservoir; both directions grouped

review.meaning: Judge headline and secondary matches against published concept definition and disambiguation; record acceptable alternatives and unresolved cases.
review.history: Same expert set is source-supported cognacy. Different sets are disagreement with this reference, not proof of wholly unrelated origins.
review.blinding: Review packet excludes pipeline labels and numeric scores.
review.gold_limits: Published expert annotations support the concept panel only. AI judgments on open vocabulary are not independent gold.

split_status: Family-grouped development/test assignment required before E1; no variants scored yet.
write_policy: Local evaluation artifacts only; no live database writes.
